[{"insert":"Sumo Deadlift

The sumo deadlift uses a wide stance with the hands gripping inside the legs. That setup shortens the pull and puts more of the work on the hips and inner thighs. Keep the chest up and push the feet apart into the floor as the bar comes up. Reps drop across the odd weeks, so the weight climbs each time it returns.
"}]
